text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
Enthusiastic cheers usher in Super<n>Creek's
conquest of the Arima Kinen.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
Following the race, Super Creek<n>rewards me by
gleefully praising me<n>as a way of expressing her
gratitude.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
With a flood of emotions, she holds<n>me in a tight
embrace.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text: Through her care, I've become a<n>top-class trainer.
